claims.evidence: Photos show generic wooden pallets but no dimensions, markings, or stamps (e.g., ISPM-15 heat-treatment stamp) are visible to confirm 'standard' size or specification.

risks.risk: Hidden rot, insect damage, or mold inside the wood not visible in daylight outdoor shots
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the underside blocks and any cut/cross-section of a board, plus a shot in different lighting or indoors
risks.if_unproven: priced as worst-case weathered/used condition, not as sound structural pallet

risks.risk: Unknown wood treatment status (heat-treated/kiln-dried vs untreated), which affects suitability for export or food-grade use
risks.proof: Photo of the ISPM-15 stamp or treatment certificate if one exists

risks.risk: Unknown load-bearing capacity and structural integrity given the visible crack in one board
risks.proof: Photo/video of the pallet being loaded or stood on, or close-up of the cracked board's extent

risks.risk: Unclear whether the sale is for a single pallet (Photos 0-1) or the full bulk stack (Photo 2), and exact unit count
risks.proof: A clear statement or photo showing the exact quantity being sold with the listing reference
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single unit only, the worst case for buyer value

risks.risk: No visible dimensions, so size cannot be confirmed against typical 'standard' pallet sizes (e.g., 1200x1000mm)
risks.proof: A photo of the pallet next to a tape measure or known-size object

proof_requests: Close-up of the underside and blocks showing any rot, insect holes, or treatment stamp
Photo with a tape measure or ruler against the pallet for size confirmation
Clarification and photo evidence of exact quantity being sold (one pallet vs full stack)
Close-up of the cracked board to assess severity
Any treatment certificate or stamp (ISPM-15) if claiming standard/export-grade pallets
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a generic wooden pallet, so it can be priced at worst-case condition and unit count pending further proof of treatment, size, and quantity.
